content.short: FereAI is a wallet-native AI agent for crypto trading across several chains.
content.description: FereAI provides an AI trading agent that works against a user's own wallet across several networks including Monad, and can be driven from chat interfaces rather than a dedicated app. Meeting users inside tools they already have open is the main distribution advantage agent products hold over conventional terminals.
content.meta: An AI trading agent that works against your own wallet and runs inside tools you already use.
